title: MusicDrop v1.3.4 Available
changelog:
• All-New Library Hub: Sticky navigation header with smooth horizontal swipe pager (All, Songs, Playlists, Folders, Albums, Artists)
• Vinyl Album Sleeves: Sleek album cards with realistic record disc peeking out of sleeve
• Dynamic Artist Avatars: Alphabetical list with vibrant letter avatars and track counts
• Smart Playlists: Favorites, Recently Added, Recently Played, and My Top Tracks with Quick Import/Restore actions
• Album & Artist Detail Pages: Dedicated view with hero cover, Shuffle & Play buttons, and 320K/date stamps
• Floating Scroll-to-Top Button: Quick navigation back to top in Songs and Detail screens
